The United States has produced many celebrated composers across a wide range of styles. While “most famous” is subjective, here are some of the most widely recognized and influential American composers:

| **Leonard Bernstein** (1918–1990) | *West Side Story*, *On the Town*, *Candide* |
| **John Williams** (born 1942) | Film scores for *Star Wars*, *Indiana Jones*, *Jurassic Park*, *Harry Potter* |
| **Philip Glass** (born 1937) | Minimalist works such as *Glassworks*, *Einstein on the Beach* |
| **Samuel Barber** (1910–1981) | *Adagio for Strings*, *Knoxville: Summer of 1915* |
